column1: # Each guide's steps and notes (guides.tsv), in order within each part. The words are Watch's strings (android/watch/
# src/main/res/values/strings_untranslated.xml, translated under ADR 0030); the tool's labels fill them in.
#   part     on (turn proxy mode on and start), password (set the proxy's user name and password), asks (what the tool
#            asks for), back (go back to VPN mode), note (a fact the user needs, or the page of a tool with no steps)
#   string   the Watch string that says it
#   labels   what fills the string's places, in order, comma separated: a key of guide-labels.tsv for this guide, or
#   source   the line of the tool's code (at guides.tsv's commit) that shows it; 'sources.tsv' where tools.tsv's own
#            evidence for the tool's row holds it
